name: NGC 6316 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6316, a globular cluster in the Milky Way's bulge, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6316-hubble
story: A globular cluster deep in the Milky Way's central bulge, likely born there rather than captured. Hubble watched its stars over time to trace how they move within the cluster.

claims.text: NGC 6316 is a bulge globular cluster that formed in situ
HST program 15232 measures internal proper motions of stars in Galactic globular clusters including NGC 6316
